title: Machoke Removes Its Belt Only for a Truly Mighty Enemy

direction.premise: Machoke's power-save belt controls its dangerous energy, but a mighty enemy can trigger its removal.
direction.audiencePromise: See why Machoke keeps its belt on, and what happens when a truly mighty enemy makes it come off.
direction.openLoop: What kind of enemy makes Machoke unleash everything?
direction.payoff: The belt comes off only against a truly mighty enemy, releasing Machoke's full power.
direction.engagementQuestion: Is removing it courage, or a last resort?

voice.instructions: Sound like a knowledgeable fan sharing a dangerous secret. Start tight and curious, build pressure through the belt removal, then land the final question with a playful pause. Keep the pace quick but clear.

scenes.headline: MIGHTY ENEMY? BELT OFF.
scenes.narration: Machoke removes its belt only for mighty enemies.
scenes.caption: THE BELT COMES OFF ONLY WHEN IT COUNTS

scenes.headline: POWER UNDER CONTROL
scenes.narration: The belt suppresses energy, keeping its dangerous power under control.
scenes.caption: POWER-SAVE BELT: ENERGY RESTRAINED

scenes.headline: THE BELT COMES OFF
scenes.narration: But against a truly mighty enemy, Machoke takes the belt off.
scenes.caption: FACING A TRULY MIGHTY ENEMY

scenes.headline: RESTRAINT: GONE
scenes.narration: The moment it comes off, Machoke unleashes its full power.
scenes.caption: FULL POWER UNLEASHED

scenes.headline: NOT JUST A BELT
scenes.narration: So the belt stays on until the threat is truly mighty.
scenes.caption: THIS IS A POWER LOCK

scenes.headline: COURAGE OR LAST RESORT?
scenes.narration: Is removing it courage, or a last resort?
scenes.caption: WOULD YOU TAKE THE BELT OFF?
